name: Werewolf Brute form
design: A massive anthropomorphic BLACK furred wolf monster, long wolf muzzle, pointed ears, gold eyes, broad muscular hunched shoulders, huge clawed hands, torn dark indigo trousers, red leather straps. Clearly a bulky black werewolf, not human.
attack: huge claw swipe to the right
cast: crouch and roar then smash both claws down

name: Awakened Werewolf
design: A powerful anthropomorphic RED brown furred werewolf, long wolf muzzle, pointed ears, gold eyes, massive claws, dark blue torn trousers and brass leather bracers. Clearly a wolf monster, red fur differentiates awakened form from silver base and black brute.
cast: raise muzzle and howl then recover

name: Treant sapling form
design: Living tree warrior, mossy brown bark body, expressive knotted wooden face with emerald eyes, little crown of fresh green leaves, root feet and branch arms, compact and friendly but strong forest creature, no human clothes or weapons.
attack: swing a wooden branch fist right
cast: raise branch arms and spread green leaves

name: Treant flowering guardian form
design: Large living tree warrior, broad mossy brown bark body, expressive knotted wood face with green eyes, broad branch crown covered with pink flowers and green leaves, thick root feet and powerful branch arms, small leafy branch staff, no human clothes.
cast: raise branch crown and both wooden arms

name: Treant ancient form
design: Ancient living tree guardian, massive gnarled bark torso, expressive venerable wooden face with green eyes, branching antler crown with orange autumn leaves and pink blossoms, small glowing green runes carved in chest, thick root feet and giant branch arms, no human clothing.
attack: slam wooden branch fist to the right
cast: raise rune carved arms and spread branch crown
